_comment: Helper programs bundled under bin/, pinned by URL and SHA-256. fetch_binaries.py
reads this file. A tool has one archive (url, sha256, executables) or a list of
'archives' with those keys; 'executables' maps a bin/ name to an archive member.
'license_members' are copied from the (first) archive into THIRD_PARTY/<name>/;
'licenses' entries with a url are fetched and verified separately; 'notice' is

two weeks). macos-arm64 FFmpeg: Martin Riedl's GPL v3 static release build of the
same 8.1 branch, from its versioned download path (old builds stay listed and online).
